title: Saronic footer
description: An ink footer built as a grid of hairline cells. Desktop: a narrow first column (a big mark that tints on hover, a careers cell with a lime button, the address and legal lines), then two wide columns of huge grey links that brighten on hover, the last with social icons and a mono X / Y readout that follows the pointer. Phones: one merged link list first, then careers, address, the mark and a centred copyright.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class) and uses the theme's card colour as its ground
the pointer readout needs JavaScript; without it the chips show a dash
made for two link groups (one per wide column on desktop)
name: saronic-footer
